name: dnr-flat-pic
title_zh: 不描边不追光影，只留身份与空间关系的扁平化压缩
tagline_zh: 不是描边转矢量，是语义压缩：保留身份和空间关系，去掉渐变、光晕、纹理、文字和 logo，复杂度压到 6/10 以下。
tagline_en: Semantic compression, not tracing: keep identity and spatial relations, remove gradients, glow, texture, text and logos, cap complexity at 6/10.
desc_en: Semantic compression, not tracing: keep identity and spatial relations, remove gradients, glow, texture, text and logos, cap complexity at 6/10.
why_zh: 它把「简化」定义成可核对的规则——固定 HSB 实色、硬边界、无光效，所以一批图能保持同一套语言。
why_en: It defines simplification as checkable rules — fixed-HSB solid fills, crisp edges, no light effects — so a set stays in one language.
limit_zh: 默认复杂度 6/10 以下，细节多的照片会被大幅删减，想保留纹理或渐变的别装。它删文字、数字、UI 元素是硬规则，带字的海报会被清空。
limit_en: Detail-heavy photos get heavily cut; text, numbers and UI are removed as a hard rule.
title_en: Flatten by semantics, not tracing: keep identity, drop.
